answer: Start from unlinkable credential with single-use show. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. Faking 579 identities means 579 fresh proofs and 68901 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One plume of signal, one delta of cost, one ledge of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
